entries.100年のカギをつかった: I used the key of 100 years.
entries.100年の鍵をつかった: I used the key from 100 years ago.
entries.かみつき草の花をつかった: I used the flowers of the biting grass.
entries.奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、\nそのまま上に上がると 奥の:
You can jump onto the wall at the back using the ↑ and × buttons,
and if you go up from there, you can walk along the back line.
To return to the front, do the opposite.
entries.木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転\nどんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい\n方向と:
When hanging from a tree branch → rotate
It gets faster and faster. I want to jump.
Use direction and the × button to jump out!
entries.○ボタンをおしつづけると、\nより強力な攻撃ができる:
If you continue pressing the ○ button,
you can perform a more powerful attack.
entries.人と話すときは ○ボタン: When talking to people, press the ○ button.
entries.ここがセーブポイントです。\n↑で奥を向いているときに\n○を押せばセーブができ:
This is the save point.
When facing backward with ↑,
pressing ○ will save.
entries.この土地は はじめてか?\n\nオレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、\nなんか:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!
entries.よぉ、にィちゃんも\nこの先に行きたいのかい?\n\nそりゃぁムリだ・・・\nこ:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...
entries.まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば\n何とかなるみたいだけど・・・\:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!
entries.オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ\n何か たべるもん ないか?・・・\:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.
entries.オ〜〜〜ッ!\nなんだ それくれるのか?\n\nサンキュー! たすかったゼ\nも:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.
entries.そうだ!!\nとっておきの技をおしえてやるョ\n\nいいか?:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?
entries.×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、\n人よんで ケモノダッシュってい: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.
entries.おぼえたか?\n×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・\nじゃぁオレはいくゼ\n\:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!
entries.・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!\n\nかくれてたんだけど よくわかった:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...
entries.よし! いいことおしえてやるよ\n\nこの小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるい:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.
entries.え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・\nそんなことより まず行ってみろよ、\nウソ:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.
entries.100年老人には会ったのかい?\n\n会ったら また会おうや:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.
entries.ふるいけ には行ったかい?\n\n行ったら また会おうや:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.
entries.どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ\n\nじまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってん:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.
entries.・・・あぁ、オイラかい?\n\nオイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...
entries.いつも かくれてるんだけど、\nだれも見つけられないんだ・・・\n\nまた見つけ:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.
entries.う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・\nがんばって見つけてくれよ\n\n:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!
entries.この先に行く気か?\n\nでも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?
entries.いかん、いかん\n\n今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが\n次からそうはいかん\:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!
entries.・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・\n\nどーしたもんかのォ・・・\n\nんっ:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?
entries.なんじゃ?・・・\nわしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?
entries.すまんが、ちょっと\n考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・\n\n・・・おお そう:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?
entries.しんぱいじゃからな・・・\nたのんだぞ:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?\n\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\nじゃが まだ残っとる:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...

Sorry, could you go again?
entries.集めてくれたのか?・・・\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\n\nじゃが まだ残っとるようじゃ:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmm...

But it seems there's still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・\nおおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではな:
What? Already gathered...?
Ohhhhh! And they're all gathered!
...And where are the contents?
entries.おー・まい・がっ!!\n\nハラの中に入れとったのか!?\n\nまぁ、しかし 消:
Oh my god!!

Did you put it in the stomach!?

Well, but it doesn't seem to be digested,
so I'll leave it at that.

Well, anyway, it was exhausting.
...With this, I'm relieved too.

Hmm?...That's right, that's right.
It seems like there was something you wanted from me.

...Hmm...
Did Komabuta take the memento arm of Ojiisan?

And you want to ask about Komabuta and the others...

Hmm, I understand...
Actually...

...I want to say that, but
This version ends here.
Hmm~ That's disappointing...

Please enjoy the rest on the product page...

There are plenty of events and actions, so
I'm sure you'll like it...
Please watch the following movies...

...Bravery boy
The adventure has just begun
I'm waiting for you on the product page...
entries.集めてくれたのか?\n\n・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな\n・・・・・:
Did you gather them?

...Oh! It looks like everything's been collected.
...And where are the contents?
entries.わしが話してやれる事はここまでじゃ・・・\n\nもしおまえさんがこの先の方を進む:
This is as far as I can go in telling you...

If you're going to move forward from here,
you should try looking for my companions,
and I'm sure they'll be able to help you...
entries.もちろん、わしの力になれることじゃったら\n何でも協力してやるからの・・・\n\:
Of course, if there's anything I can do to help,
I'll cooperate with you...

...That's right,

I have confidence in my abilities, so
if you get something you don't know how to use,
bring it to me...
entries.おや?ないのぉ・・・\nおまえさんに100年のすずを\nやろうとおもったんじゃが:
Oh? It's gone...
I was going to give you a hundred years of tin...

It seems like you lost it somewhere...

If you find something like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this... Here, take this—it's a hundred-year key.
entries.これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら\nあけることができるようになったはずじゃ・:
With this, you should now be able to open the same treasure chests as the ones here...
Hmm, what luck!
entries.それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、\n封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・\:
And... to find the Demon Pig, you need something called a Seal Pouch...

Without it,
the hiding place becomes invisible...
entries.封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む\nドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・\:
As for the sealed bag, you should ask the elder of the dwarves who live in the forest ahead...
He should be able to tell you more about it.
entries.なんじゃ、わからない物があるなら見せてごらん・・・: What? If there's something you don't understand, show it to me...
entries.・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!\nよく見つけたのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
...Oh wow, this is exactly 100 years of Suzu!
You found it well...

If you use this, you should be able to come back here anytime...
entries.カエル水にかえる: The frog returns to the water.
entries.コッカタマゴの中身: The contents of a cockerel egg.
entries.かみつき草の花: The flowers of the biting grass.
entries.かえり道をわすれたカエル: The frog who forgot its way home.
entries.かえられなくなった\nドワーフのこども:
I can't be changed anymore.
Dwarf child.
entries.何でもふき飛ばす\n強力なたつまき:
Blows everything away
A powerful gale
entries.100年老人の小屋へ\nいつでも もどれる:
To the 100-year-old man's cabin,
I can always return.
entries.ある宝箱に合うと\nひらく事ができる:
When it fits into a treasure chest,
you can open it.
entries.一度行った場所へ\nいつでも 行ける:
To a place I once went,
I can always go.
entries.かみつき草にさいた\nめずらしい花:
I planted it in the grass.
A rare flower.
entries.遠くの景色が\n見られる: You can see the distant scenery.
entries.とてもきれいな\nからの小ビン: A very beautiful small bottle from.
entries.涙のつまった小ビン: A small bottle filled with tears.
entries.あしをケガしたこいぬ: A puppy with an injured leg.
entries.枯れ葉の羽を持つ\n伝説のチョウチョ:
A butterfly with wings of withered leaves,
a legendary butterfly.
entries.水がたっぷり\n入ったバケツ: A bucket filled with plenty of water.
entries.なにも うつさないカガミ: A mirror that doesn't reflect anything.
entries.たかい所から\nユラユラおりられる:
From a high place,
you can sway down.
entries.コウテツでできた 強力な\nブーメラン: A powerful boomerang made of kouetsu.
entries.魔ブタを封じこめる\nたいせつな ふくろ:
Sealing the demon pig
A precious pouch
entries.せかいを 見わたす\nべんりな地図: A convenient map that covers the world.
entries.はじめから はいている\nパンツ:
I've been wearing them from the beginning.
Pants.
entries.コマブタにとられた うでわを\nもとめて たびだつ: I'm going to retrieve the arm taken by the pig.
entries.ものしりな100年老人に\n会いに行く: I'm going to meet a knowledgeable 100-year-old.
entries.およげないと ダメらしい: It seems like I can't do it unless I run.
entries.まどから のぞいている人と\n話しをした: I talked to the person peeking through the window.
entries.おおきな みずたまり\nの話を きいた: I heard a story about a big puddle.
entries.かくれていた人の\nなまえを しった: I learned the name of the person who was hiding.
entries.たまごの なかみを\nあつめる: Gather the contents of the egg.
entries.魔ブタが出たときの\n話を きいた: I heard the story when the demon pig appeared.
entries.森でまいごになった\nこどもを さがす:
Lost in the forest
Searching for a child
entries.森でいなくなった ドワーフたちを さがす: Search for the dwarves who disappeared in the forest.
entries.地下のオオドロボウと話しをする: Talk to the Oodorobou in the basement.
entries.サルのサンタは おなかが すいているようだ\nなにか たべものを さがしてこよう: The monkey Santa seems hungry. Shall I go look for something to eat?

messages.original: あばれ竜巻をつかった

messages.translation: I used the key of 100 years.
I used the key from 100 years ago.

messages.original: めぐみの羽根をつかった
かみつき草の花をつかった
messages.translation: I used the flowers of the biting grass.

messages.original: ライフゲージかくだい

奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、
そのまま上に上がると 奥のラインを歩けるよ
手前にもどりたいときはその逆だよ
messages.translation:
You can jump onto the wall at the back using the ↑ and × buttons,
and if you go up from there, you can walk along the back line.
To return to the front, do the opposite.

messages.original:
木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転
どんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい
方向と×ボタンで飛び出す!
messages.translation:
When hanging from a tree branch → rotate
It gets faster and faster. I want to jump.
Use direction and the × button to jump out!

messages.original:
○ボタンをおしつづけると、
より強力な攻撃ができる
messages.translation:
If you continue pressing the ○ button,
you can perform a more powerful attack.

messages.original: 人と話すときは ○ボタン
messages.translation: When talking to people, press the ○ button.

messages.original:
ここがセーブポイントです。
↑で奥を向いているときに
○を押せばセーブができます
messages.translation:
This is the save point.
When facing backward with ↑,
pressing ○ will save.

messages.original:
この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

messages.original:
よぉ、にィちゃんも
この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!

messages.original:
オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?

messages.original:
×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、
人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.

messages.original:
おぼえたか?
×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・
じゃぁオレはいくゼ

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!

messages.original:
・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや

・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・

どーしたもんかのォ・・・

んっ?
messages.translation:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?

messages.original:
なんじゃ?・・・
わしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?
messages.translation:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?

messages.original:
すまんが、ちょっと
考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・

・・・おお そうじゃ!!
ちょっと おまえさん、たのまれてくれんか?
たのみというのはのォ・・・

おまえさんも ここへ来るとき 見たと思うが、
赤いトリのコッカのやつめ、

よそからタマゴを盗んできては、
ああやって自分のものにしておってな・・・

あのままでは
中のヒナが かわいそうなんじゃ・・・

そこでおまえさん、このへんにあるタマゴの中にいる
ヒナを全部 集めてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?

messages.original:
しんぱいじゃからな・・・
たのんだぞ
messages.translation:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?

ん〜〜〜っ・・・
じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・

すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...
